name: runlog-monorepo
description: An extensible engine for dice-driven creative-practice games.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/container/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/rules-schema/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p hosted/infra/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:stage: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/stage.ts 0.0.0-check && node packages/cli/stage/dist/runlog.js validate packs/demo/pack.yaml --strict && node -e "import('./packages/cli/stage/dist/index.js').then(m => { if (typeof m.seal !== 'function') throw new Error('no seal export') })"
scripts.check:packs: npm run runlog -- validate packs/demo/pack.yaml packs/demo/any-given-day.yaml packs/sketches/salt-and-signal.yaml packs/sketches/ladder-work.yaml packs/sketches/rocket-league-ladder.yaml packs/sketches/elden-ring-expedition.yaml packs/sketches/homefront.yaml packs/sketches/practice-room.yaml packs/sketches/pantry-roulette.yaml packs/sketches/elden-ring-trial.yaml packs/sketches/rocket-league-showdown.yaml packs/sketches/twenty-five.yaml packs/sketches/frog-first.yaml packs/sketches/two-doors.yaml packs/sketches/word-count.yaml packs/sketches/the-backlog.yaml packs/sketches/sunday-desk.yaml packs/sketches/run-of-show.yaml packs/testing/engine-testing.yaml --strict
scripts.test:packs: npm run runlog -- test packs/demo/pack.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/demo/any-given-day.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/salt-and-signal.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/ladder-work.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/rocket-league-ladder.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/elden-ring-expedition.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/homefront.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/practice-room.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/pantry-roulette.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/elden-ring-trial.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/rocket-league-showdown.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/twenty-five.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/frog-first.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/two-doors.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/word-count.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/the-backlog.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/sunday-desk.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/sketches/run-of-show.yaml && npm run runlog -- test packs/testing/engine-testing.yaml
